semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: The source uses finite Euclidean predictors; Lean treats complete real Hilbert spaces. Nonnegative threshold is source-implicit, and the valid zero-threshold extension is explicit. Arbitrary deterministic feature/label streams replace the illustrative stock history. The explicit constants and terminal residual are derived using the shared positive fixed-step OGD theorem. Coefficient-one eta_T=1/sqrt(T) selects a separate known-horizon run for each positive T. Only the numerical upper envelope tends to zero; actual signed average regret is eventually below each positive epsilon for each fixed comparator. One complete Huber module with three definitions and nineteen theorems, fourteen original canary proofs and five inherited scalar-value consumers. Fixed-step regret covers every natural horizon including zero and retains the negative terminal distance. The tuned average guarantee requires positive horizon. No bounded labels, residuals, predictors or diameter are assumed. No signed or absolute regret convergence to zero, real-limsup theorem, uniform comparator cutoff, anytime schedule, stochastic/financial performance, whole-chapter acceptance, full purification or Exposition Seal is established.
